query:
SELECT release AS "release!", id AS "id!"
                FROM (
                    SELECT release, id,
                           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY release ORDER BY id) AS rn
                    FROM medium
                    WHERE release = ANY($1)
                      AND ($2::int IS NULL OR id > $2)
                ) ranked
                WHERE rn <= $3
                ORDER BY release, id
